subject: Sandbox runway extension request — Integratek SDK regression + SAML rotation
messages:
From: Sophie Martin <sophie@integratek.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sandbox runway request — blocked by SDK regression + SAML rotation

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We hit a hard blocker overnight that will prevent the scheduled demo next Tuesday unless we get more runway in the sandbox. Two related things are tripping our engineers:

1) After upgrading to Integratek SDK v2.4 in our staging environment, we started seeing intermittent NullPointerExceptions during token exchange (stacktrace attached). The SDK team is investigating but there are a few native dependency differences between our runtime and Redwood's recommended env.

2) We rotated our IdP SAML certificate as part of a routine security cadence and now SAML assertions are failing validation inside our connector code (SAML responses return IssuerMismatch / InvalidSignature errors). That broke provisioning and the onboarding flow.

We need an extension to our sandbox window while our eng team (and hopefully your engineering partners) help triage. Ideally a 3-week extension, but we can proceed if you can approve 2 weeks immediately. We have a compliance demo on the 24th and missing the demo will delay procurement.

I can send logs and the SDK stacktrace — attaching a quick export of the failing request/response and the trace. If you can also provide a temporary debug token scoped to our project for 48 hours (read-only) it would massively speed up root-cause analysis.

Attachments: saml-rotation.log, sdk-stacktrace.txt

Appreciate any help you can provide — Sophie
Sophie Martin
Director of Product
Integratek

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie@integratek.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Apr 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox runway request — blocked by SDK regression + SAML rotation

Hi Sophie — thanks for the details and for sending the logs. Sorry to hear this hit right before your demo window.

We can absolutely help. Initial proposals:
- Immediate: grant a 14-day sandbox extension today so your team gets breathing room while we triage.
- Technical: I’ve looped in David from our infra/connector team to review the logs and propose a short-term workaround (e.g., pinning the older cert or a fallback validation path).

To proceed please:
- Confirm that the saml-rotation.log and sdk-stacktrace.txt you attached cover the failing flows (they appear to, from my quick scan).
- Share any GitHub issue numbers or PRs for your SDK upgrade so we can correlate code changes.
- If acceptable, we can generate a 48-hour read-only debug token scoped to the Integratek sandbox — confirm the preferred token expiry and whether we should restrict it to staging only.

I’m attaching the integration-checklist.pdf we usually use during these runs (small checklist and the debug token process).

David — can you take first pass on the logs? Ben — I’ll follow up with internal approval for the two-week extension and confirm formally once I have finance sign-off for the sandbox dates.

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

On Fri, Apr 3, 2027 at 09:12 Sophie Martin <sophie@integratek.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We hit a hard blocker overnight that will prevent the scheduled demo next Tuesday unless we get more runway in the sandbox...

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Martin <sophie@integratek.com>, integratek-support@integratek.com
Date: Sat, 4 Apr 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox runway request — blocked by SDK regression + SAML rotation

Thanks Naomi — I pulled the saml-rotation.log and sdk-stacktrace.txt. Quick summary of what I see:

- The stacktrace shows the NPE originates when the SDK tries to parse the IdP's AssertionConsumerService URL; it looks like an unexpected null on the binding metadata (this aligns with v2.4 shipping a stricter parser).
- The SAML log indicates the IdP signature is present but the Issuer element in the assertion does not match the expected entityID in a handful of cases; looks like a cert rotation process that updated JWKs before the metadata was fully propagated to service configs.

Short-term options (fastest):
1) Revert to SDK v2.3.8 while we prepare a patch for 2.4.x — that removes the stricter parser behavior.
2) If revert isn’t possible, we can ask you to supply the prior (pre-rotation) metadata snapshot so we can accept both issuer variants for a short window.

If you can share a minimal reproduction (curl request + SAML response) and confirm the GitHub issue link, I can have a dev patch PR ready in ~48 hours. For debugging we’ll need the following artifacts:
- full SAML response payload(s) (XML) for the failing attempts
- the exact SDK version + runtime (JRE) and container image tag used in staging

I can also sign a constrained temporary token for us to run an isolated trace against your staging environment. Naomi — I think the 14-day extension you suggested should be sufficient unless the patch takes longer — we’ll update you as we triage.

David
David Kim
Senior Software Engineer, Redwood Inference

On Fri, Apr 3, 2027 at 10:22 Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Sophie — thanks for the details and for sending the logs. Sorry to hear this hit right before your demo window...

From: Sophie Martin <sophie@integratek.com>

Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 14:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox runway request — blocked by SDK regression + SAML rotation

Hi Naomi / David / Ben —

Thanks for the quick triage. We’ll accept the 14-day extension for now. I uploaded the requested artifacts to this thread (saml-rotation.log, sdk-stacktrace.txt) and attached a minimal reproduction (small curl + SAML response) to the support ticket.

Quick answers:
- GitHub issue: https://github.com/integratek/integratek-sdk/issues/118
- Runtime: openjdk 11, container tag integratek/staging:20270401
- We can provide the previous metadata snapshot if you want us to drop it into a secure share.

Please go ahead and generate a read-only debug token scoped to the Integratek sandbox, expiring 48 hours after issuance. Let me know if you need any additional info.

Appreciate the help — Sophie

Attachments in this email: saml-rotation.log (text), sdk-stacktrace.txt (text)
